Per Vices develops high-performance, wideband software defined radio transceivers and receivers with up to 16 independent radio channels. Our SDR platforms provide the RF performance, bandwidth, channel count and data throughput required for demanding RF systems.

Start with a proven, high-performance SDR platform instead of developing custom radio hardware from the ground up. Reduce development effort, integration complexity and technical risk while maintaining a platform that can scale from development through deployment.
